title: HC triage + interview-loop prep (noah)
content:
Context:
Quick notes for prep with Maya (hiring lead) and Sasha (eng manager) before weekly HC sync and interview-loop debrief. Personal scratchpad — messy, feel free to prune for the meeting.

Primary goals for this sync:
- Triage open reqs: decide ’keep open / pause / escalate’ for each role.
- Standardize debrief format so hiring managers and interviewers are consistent.
- Short list operational fixes to reduce time-to-offer by 20% for high-priority roles.

Meeting logistics:
- 30 minutes (standup format).
- Bring 1 slide per hiring manager: update + top blocker + decision ask.
- Outcome: owner + 2 action items per paused/escalted req, ETA for next touchpoint.

Snapshot (pipeline counts as of this morning):
- SWE-Backend (priority A): 16 apps, 6 phone screens, 2 onsites scheduled.
- SWE-Inference infra (priority A+): 9 apps, 3 take-home, 0 offers.
- Product PM (priority B): 7 apps, 4 screens, 1 onsites.
- SRE (priority B): 12 apps, 2 screens.
- Designer (priority C): 5 apps, recruiting paused.

Decisions I want from the sync:
- Freeze designer req until after org mapping (budget constraint from finance ticket JIRA-PO-88).
- For inference infra: authorize two more interview slots (internal hiring committee ok?). Need final approval from Sasha.

Interview-loop changes proposal (quick):
- Reduce take-home to 48 hrs turn-around + one template for most infra roles (standardize grading rubric).
- Combine system-design + coding into one 90-min session for mid-senior backend roles to reduce interviews and candidate drop-off.
- Add explicit scorecard field: "operational impact" (0-4) — helps prioritize final offers when compensation differences small.

Debrief template (we'll trial for 3 weeks):
1) Candidate + role + date
2) Summary (1-2 lines)
3) Strengths (bullets)
4) Concerns (bullets)
5) Scorecard numbers (tech, collaboration, ownership, op-impact)
6) Recommend: hire / no-hire / hold + reason
7) Owner to follow-up + next action (e.g., reference check, hiring committee prep)

Quick scoring rubric idea (for conversation):
- Tech (0-4), Collaboration (0-4), Ownership (0-4), Op-impact (0-4).
- Total >=13 and no red flags -> recommend hire.
- Flag if any category == 0 (auto hold until sync).

Operational fixes (low-hanging):
- Recruiter templates: swap in role-specific preferred skills to speed screeners. (Owner: Maya, ETA 1 week).
- Interviewer calibration: 30-min mini-training + sample rubric yesterday -> run next Tue with Kenji.
- Automated scheduling: set 2 recurring blocks per day for interviewers so we can book within 48 hrs. (Owner: Sasha, follow up with infra team).

Risks / blockers:
- Budget freeze rumor from finance (see JIRA-PO-88) — verify before committing to additional offers.
- Interviewer burnout — many engineers declining panels due to Q1 project push. Need backup interviewer pool (solutions eng?).
- Slow comp approvals — average 6 days in approvals queue last month.

Follow-ups to assign in meeting (template):
- Action item, owner, due date, slack channel to update.
Example: "Authorize two extra on-sites for inference infra"; Owner: Sasha; Due: 2026-03-04; Post status in #hiring-ops.

Notes-to-self / rough talking points:
- Emphasize to Maya: prefer narrow baking of roles (A vs B) so we can direct resources.
- Ask Sasha: can we reuse infrastructure interviewers from other squads who have more capacity?
- Bring up comp queue metric to hiring manager — show tradeoffs if we push faster: more approvals needed.

Open questions (need answers before decisions):
- Finance: confirm if Q1 headcount reserve can be flexed for 2 high-priority hires (linked to JIRA-PO-88).
- Legal/compliance: any new requirements for inference infra candidates (data access, background checks)?
- Bench: how many internal transfer candidates are in play (I think 2 for backend)?

Potential escalations (criteria):
- If offer acceptance drops below 40% for a role after 3 offers, escalate to leadership for compensation review.
- If time-to-offer > 30 days for priority A roles twice in a row -> open emergency hiring task force.

Misc quick references (for meeting):
- Confluence page: hc-plan-q1-2026 (link above)
- JIRA tickets: JIRA-ENG-1427 (interview scheduling), JIRA-PO-88 (finance hold)
- Slack: #hiring-ops, #eng-leads

End of scratchpad.

-- Noah
